ns2:course.label: Topics in Drama
ns2:course.description: Seminar covering advanced topics (such as genre, performance context, period, or theme) in drama studies. Same as CWL 465. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. May be repeated with permission of English advising office to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours if topics vary. Graduate students may repeat as topics vary. Prerequisite: One year of college literature or consent of instructor.
